Next.js 15 + Prisma app with an admin portal + a live-chat support system. Work ONLY in the git worktree /opt/nxeon-wt-mktg (NOT /opt/nxeon). Do NOT run git/npm build/prisma. Edit files only. IMPORTANT: do NOT edit prisma/schema.prisma or worker/hosting.ts or lib/actions-hosting.ts (other agents own those). Avoid new DB columns — use existing data/settings.

FEATURE (from the board): "Notifications for Admin — notification sounds when the admin portal tab is open and a new live-chat message arrives, plus email notifications to haxkodi@gmail.com."

STEP 1 — INVESTIGATE the existing live-chat/support system:
- Find the live chat + admin support inbox. Search: `grep -rln "live chat\|liveChat\|ChatMessage\|chatMessage\|support\|Ticket\|ticket" components/admin app/admin lib --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts | head -40`. Identify: the Prisma model for chat/support messages, how admins currently see new messages (an admin inbox page/component, likely components/admin/… or app/admin/support|chat|inbox), and whether there's already any polling/unread mechanism (e.g. the customer mail nav polls an unread count — see components/portal/Shell.tsx for a `fetch` unread pattern to mirror).
- Find the transactional mailer: `grep -rln "sendMail\|sendEmail\|nodemailer\|mailer\|transactional" lib | head`. Read its signature (how to send an email server-side). Also check lib/settings.ts SETTINGS_DEFAULTS for any admin-notification email setting.

STEP 2 — BROWSER SOUND + NOTIFICATION (admin tab open):
- Add a small client component (e.g. components/admin/AdminChatNotifier.tsx, "use client") that runs inside the admin layout (mount it in app/admin/layout.tsx or the admin shell). It polls the existing "new/unread live-chat messages" source (reuse an existing server action or API route; if none returns an unread/latest-chat count, add a tiny read-only API route or server action that returns the count of live-chat messages awaiting admin reply — READ-ONLY, no schema change) every ~10s. When the count INCREASES while the tab is open, it: (a) plays a short notification sound, and (b) fires a Web Notification (request permission once; guard for unsupported/denied). 
- The sound: generate a short beep via the Web Audio API (no asset needed) OR reference an existing /public sound if one exists — prefer Web Audio to avoid adding binaries. Respect the tab being visible (document.visibilityState) — only sound/notify when appropriate (per the card: when the admin portal tab is open).
- Keep it self-contained + defensive (never throw if Notification/AudioContext unavailable). Do not spam: only notify on a genuine increase, debounce.

STEP 3 — EMAIL NOTIFICATION to haxkodi@gmail.com:
- When a NEW live-chat message from a customer arrives, send an email to haxkodi@gmail.com via the existing mailer (subject like "New Nxeon live chat message", body with the customer name/message snippet + a link to the admin chat). Wire this at the point a customer chat message is CREATED server-side (find the server action/route that persists an inbound live-chat message — likely where the customer widget posts). Guard it: fire-and-forget (`.catch(()=>{})`), don't block the message write, and avoid emailing on admin's OWN replies (only inbound/customer messages). If there's a risk of flooding, it's acceptable to email at most once per conversation per short window — implement a simple guard if easy, else just email per inbound message. Prefer reading the destination from an existing setting if one exists, else hardcode haxkodi@gmail.com in a clearly-commented const.

CONSTRAINTS: no schema changes; reuse existing models/actions/mailer; edit only admin/chat/support components + the admin layout + the live-chat message create path + optionally a small read-only API route. Match existing code style. Keep everything defensive so a notification failure never breaks chat or the admin portal.

REPORT (concise): the files you changed/created; the live-chat model + the exact server-side create point you hooked for email; how the browser poll/sound/notification works and where it's mounted; how you got the unread/new-message signal (existing action vs new read-only route); confirm no schema change and that email is fire-and-forget + only on inbound customer messages.

Example prompts (not exhaustive) are 'implement this Figma design', 'build this screen from Figma', 'turn this Figma into code', 'design to code'. This is the preferred workflow skill whenever the user wants to build or update a full page, modal, dialog, drawer, sidebar, panel, or any composed multi-section view in Figma from code or a description. Discovers design system components, variables, and styles from Code Connect files, existing screens, and library search, then imports them and assembles views incrementally section-by-section using design system tokens instead of hardcoded values.

Trigger whenever the user asks to create, generate, draw, render, sketch, or build a diagram — flowchart, architecture diagram, sequence diagram, ERD or entity-relationship diagram, state diagram or state machine, gantt chart, or timeline. Also trigger when the user mentions Mermaid syntax or wants a system architecture, decision tree, dependency graph, API call flow, auth handshake, schema, or pipeline visualized in FigJam. Also use when the user asks to create or generate any component in Figma — even a single one — since components require proper variable foundations, variant states, and design token bindings to be production-quality. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.

Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. - anthropic-skills:setup-cowork: Guided Cowork setup — install role-matched plugins, connect your tools, try a skill.
- anthropic-skills:skill-creator: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
- anthropic-skills:xlsx: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

## Summary

Feature: admin notification sounds + Web Notifications when the admin tab is open and a new live-chat message arrives, plus email alerts to haxkodi@gmail.com. All work in `/opt/nxeon-wt-mktg`, edits only, no schema changes.

### Live-chat model + create points
- Model: `chatConversation` (with `unreadForAgent` flag) + `chatMessage` (`sender: "visitor"` | `"agent"`), plus `chatAttachment`.
- Inbound (customer) messages are persisted in two places — the exact server-side points I hooked for email:
  - `app/api/chat/route.ts` POST (text messages)
  - `app/api/chat/upload/route.ts` POST (image attachments)
- Agent replies live in `lib/actions-chat.ts` — deliberately NOT hooked, so admins never get emailed for their own replies.

### Files created
- `app/api/admin/chat-unread/route.ts` — read-only GET returning `{ count }` of `chatConversation.count({ where: { unreadForAgent: true } })`, gated with `realUser()` + `canAccess(role, "support")` (mirrors the sidebar badge signal). Fails soft to 0. No writes.
- `components/admin/AdminChatNotifier.tsx` — `"use client"` component; polls `/api/admin/chat-unread` every 10s. On a genuine count INCREASE it plays a ~0.35s 880Hz Web Audio beep (no binary asset) and fires a `Notification` (permission requested once). Guarded: only when `document.visibilityState === "visible"`, first poll never alerts (ref starts null), 4s debounce, and every AudioContext/Notification/fetch call is wrapped so it can never throw. Renders `null`.
- `lib/chat-notify.ts` — `notifyAdminInboundChat(...)`, a fire-and-forget helper. Sends via existing `sendMail` (subject `New Nxeon live chat message from <who>`, body = customer name/email + escaped snippet + a button to `/admin/chat`). Flood guard: at most one email per conversation per 5-minute window (best-effort in-memory Map). Destination is a clearly-commented const `ADMIN_CHAT_NOTIFY_TO = "haxkodi@gmail.com"` (no existing setting for it). Whole body wrapped in try/catch.

### Files edited
- `app/admin/layout.tsx` — imports and mounts `<AdminChatNotifier />` once inside the `Shell` (covers every admin page).
- `app/api/chat/route.ts` and `app/api/chat/upload/route.ts` — after the message write, call `notifyAdminInboundChat(...)` as `void ...catch(()=>{})` so it never awaits, delays, or breaks the widget response.

### Confirmations
- No schema/prisma changes; did not touch `prisma/schema.prisma`, `worker/hosting.ts`, or `lib/actions-hosting.ts`.
- Reused existing mailer (`sendMail`/`layout`/`button`), existing `appUrl`, and existing `unreadForAgent` signal via a new tiny read-only route.
- Email is fire-and-forget and only fires on inbound customer messages (visitor POST paths), never on admin agent replies.
- Did not run git/npm/prisma per instructions.

One note: the beep depends on a prior user gesture in the tab (browser autoplay policy) — admins interacting with the portal satisfies this; the code degrades silently if the AudioContext is blocked, and the Web Notification still fires independently.
